$comment: Docs under docs/i18n/ that may cite a message key the English catalogs no longer hold. `retired` is permanent: a guide sometimes has to name a key that is GONE, because what it records is where a translation came from. `pending` is a burn-down list of citations orphaned by key renames, kept green until each locale's fix lands. An entry with a blank reason silences nothing. Local runs drop an entry as soon as its doc stops citing the key, so neither section can grow by accident; adding one needs David's OK (.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md).

docs/i18n/de/decisions.md.askCmdr.consent.noContents: Deliberate: the paragraph records that its translation was carried over verbatim from this retired key, so naming it is the point and no live key can stand in.
